en: A black and white postcard-style image showing a mountainous landscape with large boulders, fallen trees, and forest damage in the foreground. In the background, partially obscured among the trees, there are several alpine-style buildings with characteristic steep roofs, likely a historic mountain resort or sanatorium. The setting appears to be in a highland or forested mountain area.
